subject.title: fix(codex): omit idle PreToolUse hook relays

question: Should unconfigured Codex installations continue to run native `PreToolUse` for default loop detection, or should that behavior require an explicit `tools.loopDetection.enabled=true` setting?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes a current default while the recently merged alternative preserves it behind a narrow opt-out; source-level correctness cannot determine which long-term product contract maintainers want.

options.title: Preserve current default
options.body: Keep default native loop detection active and rebase only any remaining inactive-noop elimination on the existing opt-out semantics.

options.title: Adopt explicit opt-in
options.body: Accept the branch's broader default change and document the upgrade behavior for users who rely on default loop detection.

recommendation.title: Preserve current default
recommendation.body: Keep default native loop detection active and rebase only any remaining inactive-noop elimination on the existing opt-out semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently landed the closely related compatibility-preserving configuration path.
